name: ember-terminals
description: Integrated terminals that live in ember node, not in the window: they keep running when every window is closed and reappear on any device.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Starts processes on the workspace's computer.

commands.title: Use Persistent Terminals for New Terminals and Tasks

ember.terminals.proxyUrl.description: Base URL of the DarkPyonix proxy that relays /__terms to ember node. Empty: the origin this window was loaded from.

ember.terminals.device.description: Name shown to other devices ("controlled by <device>"). Empty: derived from the browser.

ember.terminals.autoAttach.description: Show this project's running persistent terminals (started from VS Code on any device) in this window, also ones started later elsewhere.

ember.terminals.killOnClose.description: Closing a terminal with the trash icon kills its session (as with ordinary terminals). Closing or reloading the window never does.

ember.terminals.emberTermPath.description: Absolute path of the ember-term binary on the workspace's computer, used by the setup command for tasks (terminal.integrated.automationProfile.*).
